description.en: Register the REA reverse-engineering server through the built-in DSH MCP client in a separate profile bundle.

dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed l
Rainskills 是一组开源 Agent Skills，让 Codex、Claude Code、Pi Agent、 DeepSeek Harness、WorkBuddy 和 Hermes Agent 能够完成应用识别、部署、 排错、交付验证、版本管理和回滚。
description.zh: 让 AI Agent 把当前项目直接部署上线，并自动验证页面和 API 是否正常。

description.en: Mi Home (米家) control for DeepSeek Harness agents — list homes/devices, read props, control devices behind a human approval gate.
A tiny DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin
给当前 DSH 的全部会话与子代理统一附加一段额外说明和上下文：设置页分段维护、实时预览、热生效。
Task-level memory for long-horizon DSH sessions: force-injected, compaction-proof, manually mounted.
在设置页提供「归档管理」页面：按工作区浏览、批量归档、恢复，以及需要二次确认的永久删除，不额外创建 Workspace。

Reflect2Evolve memory plugin: layered L1/L2/L3 memory, reflection-weighted value backprop, cross-task policy induction, skill crystallization, and three-tier retrieval for OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and DeepSeek Harness.

A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with translucent surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的液态玻璃主题，包含半透明界面、壁纸、桌面透出、窗口模糊、自定义光标、点击涟漪和消息辨识选项。

description.en: Safe, resumable automation and analysis tools for CST Studio Suite, with task planning, solve-budget control, persistent runs, result extraction, far-field analysis, and parameter sweeps.
description.zh: 面向 CST Studio Suite 的安全、可恢复自动化与分析插件，支持任务规划、求解预算控制、持久化运行、结果提取、远场分析和参数扫描。

description.en: Registers external ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI as DSH model providers: maps each agent's thought_level options to the reasoning-effort selector, forwards images when the agent advertises promptCapabilities.image, and routes permission requests to DSH's approval dialog; ships an ACP Agents settings page that imports Zed agent_servers JSON and discovers models.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等外部 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）Agent 注册为 DSH 模型提供方：Agent 的 thought_level 选项映射为推理等级菜单，Agent 声明 promptCapabilities.image 时转发图片，权限请求走 DSH 原生审批框；附带 ACP Agents 设置页，可导入 Zed 的 agent_servers JSON 并发现模型。

description.en: Connects Trae enterprise models to DeepSeek Harness from a personal access token alone, calling llm_raw_chat directly with no trae2api or traecli process; fetches the model catalog from upstream on startup and shows remaining quota for personal packs and enterprise seats.
description.zh: 仅凭一个个人访问令牌（PAT）把 Trae 企业版模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，直连 llm_raw_chat，不需要 trae2api 或 traecli 进程；启动时从上游拉取模型目录，并显示个人额度包与企业席位的剩余额度。

description.en: Windows balloon notifications for session lifecycle events (new / running / finished / error) across all workspaces, with a session-store watch that catches headless and A2A dispatch sessions whose events never reach the host bus. Windows only.
description.zh: 会话生命周期事件（新建 / 运行中 / 完成 / 出错）的 Windows 气泡通知，覆盖所有工作区；还会监听会话存储，捕捉事件从不经过宿主总线的无头与 A2A 派发会话。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of the ayghri/i-have-adhd ruleset. One system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps, restated state and concrete time estimates. The mode is a property of one session rather than a global setting — switch it with /i-have-adhd on|off, or by typing "stop adhd mode" — and its state is folded from that session's log, so it survives resume and fork. A badge below the composer shows the current session's state.
description.zh: ayghri/i-have-adhd 规则集在 DeepSeek Harness 上的移植。一个系统提示词区段让回复行动先行、步骤编号、复述进度、时间估算用真实单位。模式是单个会话的属性而非全局设置——用 /i-have-adhd on|off 切换，也可以直接打字说 "stop adhd mode"——状态由该会话的日志折叠得出，因此 resume 与 fork 之后依然正确。输入框下方的徽标显示当前会话的状态。

description.en: Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered automatically from PATH, the managed CLI directory and a drop-in convention directory. Agents that are installed but still missing credentials or a required background service are shown as "needs setup" rather than silently hidden.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：在输入框旁边直接选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、 Qwen Code、Gemini CLI、Aider、Goose、Hermes…）作为当前会话的默认执行体，不必去改配置文件。 Agent 名册是数据驱动的，已安装的 CLI 会从 PATH、托管 CLI 目录和约定目录自动发现；装了但还缺 凭据或需要常驻服务的，会显示为「待配置」而不是被悄悄藏起来。

description.en: Movable radio pill with live visualizer, station search, favourites and self-update check for DSH Web.
description.zh: 可拖动的收音机胶囊，带实时可视化、电台搜索、收藏与自更新检查，面向 DSH Web。

description.en: Two-tab archive panel (archived / active) where every row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete; each row shows its bound workspace folder as a clickable path, and queued archive-entry cleanup keeps a deleted session from resurfacing in the active list.
description.zh: 双 Tab 归档面板（已归档 / 活跃），每行的归档或取消归档与彻底删除并排；显示绑定的工作目录且可直接点击打开，删除后的归档记录进入待清理队列，避免已删会话重新出现在活跃列表。

description.en: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider: registers an `ark-coding` route with 12 models (capacity facts measured per model), multi-account with automatic rotation, a bundled pinned arkcli for the official model catalog and live plan quota, plus a settings wizard and a sidebar usage card.
description.zh: 非官方火山方舟 Coding Plan 模型接入插件：注册 `ark-coding` 路由，12 个模型的容量事实逐项实测，多账户自动轮换，内置钉版 arkcli 拉官方模型目录与真实套餐额度，含设置向导与侧边栏用量卡片。

description.en: Forces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English on every reply and every document. Commands: /asd100 on, /asd100 off, /asd100.
description.zh: 强制所有回复和文档按 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语输出。命令：/asd100 on、/asd100 off、/asd100。

description.en: Runs one-time and recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with natural-language schedules, visual schedule editing and session-linked history. Supports custom models, skills, pause on failure, and permission settings.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或周期 Agent 任务，支持自然语言计划、可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。支持自定义模型、技能、失败时暂停以及权限设置。

description.en: Unified install for DS Bot and the Codex-style sidebar: one package that mounts both and fixes their layout conflicts (composer alignment, sidebar footer, account entry, conversation width).
description.zh: DS Bot 与 Codex 风格侧栏的合一安装：一个包同时挂载两者并修复共存时的布局冲突（输入框对齐、侧栏底部、账户入口、对话宽度）。

description.en: Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.
description.zh: 把 cc-switch 里配好的模型供应商接进 DeepSeek Harness：读取 cc-switch 数据库，将 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi 等条目转成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入 API Key，还提供实测首字节耗时与流能否正常收尾的体检。

description.en: Switches every session's thinking and answers to Chinese — terse, a little wry, plain-spoken — while keeping proper nouns in English, and adds an "answer only what was asked" interaction rule. One global system-prompt section (order 10): no UI, no binaries, no network calls. Inactive under the minimal preset, which replaces the whole prompt with its own persona.
description.zh: 让所有会话的思考与回复都说中文：简洁、略沾文言、说人话，专有名词保留英文原形；并附一条「只答所问、不主动跑命令、动手前先提醒」的交互偏好。实现只是一条全局 system-prompt 段落（order 10）：没有界面、没有二进制、不联网。切到极简预设时不生效——那个预设会把整个 prompt 换成它自己的人设。

description.en: Codex-style Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: a header button opens a menu with commit, push, branch switching and creation, and repository initialization; shows the current branch and the total additions and deletions of uncommitted files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的 Git 面板：会话头部按钮打开菜单，提供提交、推送、切换分支、创建并切换与初始化仓库；显示当前分支与未提交文件的总增减。

description.en: Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models into DeepSeek Harness. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，实时模型发现、设置页逐个启停、一键写入 provider，免 key。

description.en: Replaces rolling narrative summaries with an append-only session index, so early facts survive compaction verbatim and shadowed text stays retrievable by anchor.
description.zh: 把上下文压缩从滚动重写的叙事摘要改为只追加的会话索引：早期事实逐字保留，被压缩掉的原文可按锚点取回。

description.en: Adds a one-click Continue button beside Send that resumes a stopped turn by sending the "continue" prompt; hidden while a turn is running or the session is empty.
description.zh: 在「发送」旁加一个一键「继续」按钮：用 continue 提示词续跑已停止的一轮；轮次进行中或会话为空时不显示。

description.en: C++ audit skill: detects the target project's actual C++ standard before making any recommendation, then reports findings across RAII and ownership, move semantics, exception safety, performance and memory, containers and algorithms, concurrency, templates and compile-time, standard boundary, and type safety, ABI and interface design, each with a checkpoint, a reason, a bad-to-good example and the minimum standard.
description.zh: C++ 审查技能：先探测目标工程真实的 C++ 标准再给建议，随后按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器与算法、并发、模板与编译期、标准边界、类型安全、ABI 与接口设计逐条给出结论，每条含检查点、原因、反例→正例与适用标准。

description.en: C++ runtime info probe for Windows via CDB: cpp_trace prints variables at multiple breakpoints in one session (replaces hand-written print), cpp_probe dumps the call stack at a conditional breakpoint. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe.
description.zh: Windows + CDB 下的 C++ 运行时信息探针：cpp_trace 一次会话多断点打印变量（替换手打 print），cpp_probe 条件断点输出调用栈。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe。

description.en: Cross-workspace DSH messaging and sender navigation, with bounded same-workspace context and opt-in local Claude Code messaging.
description.zh: 支持 DSH 跨工作区消息与发送方导航、同工作区受限上下文，以及可选的本机 Claude Code 双向通信。

description.en: Daily and weekly task manager: startup popup reminder, a marquee strip above the composer, one-click circle completion, editable task cards, and a Sunday AI weekly summary, plus a sidebar DeepSeek API usage widget with balance card, today/cumulative tokens and cost, per-model breakdown and a 7-day chart. Persists as JSON under $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 每日/每周任务管理：启动弹窗提醒、输入框上方滚动条、圆圈一键完成、任务卡片编辑、周日 AI 周总结；另附侧边栏 DeepSeek API 用量小部件（余额卡片、今日与累计 tokens 及费用、按模型明细、近 7 日柱状图）。数据以 JSON 存于 $DSH_HOME。

description.en: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库浏览器：在对话区第三个页签连接 SQLite、MySQL/MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、ClickHouse、Redis、Elasticsearch 与 Qdrant——浏览结构树、分页查看数据、编辑单元格、插入行、建表/改表/删表、执行 SQL、CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown 导入导出，以及可编辑的 E-R 关系图。只读连接按语句白名单硬拒绝写路径，agent 工具默认只读、写工具需显式授权，所有写操作（含被拒尝试）进入可查可删的审计日志；附带 MCP stdio 服务器，把同一份连接暴露给任意外部 AI 客户端。

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-web` provider that drives your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com account as an extra model in DSH, so no Open Platform API key is needed: the sidebar footer lists your Web conversations, Fork to Workspace opens an independent Harness session that never writes back to the original conversation, native search stays on for the `default` model, and `/clean` is a session toggle that sends only the human text. Fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web, kept working on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2: the peer ranges are widened so the compatibility gate no longer rejects the whole bundle, the removed settings API is replaced with `ctx.settings.configure()` plus `.volatile()` config fields, the renamed client icons are updated, and an upstream SSE error now surfaces as a real error instead of an empty message that poisoned the session history. The fork also repairs what the rename to `-free` left behind: the session-list route used to derive its suffix from a hard-coded length inherited from the old package name, which had turned every conversation request into a 404 while sign-in still worked; and the sidebar conversation panel now paints on an opaque surface token instead of the host's translucent menu token, which only reads as a menu beside the backdrop blur a body-mounted panel cannot install.
description.zh: 把你已登录的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作额外模型接入 DSH：注册 `deepseek-web` provider，无需 Open Platform API key；侧边栏底部列出你的网页端会话，「Fork to Workspace」会开一个独立的 Harness 会话、不回写原对话，`default` 模型保持网页端原生搜索，`/clean` 是只发送人类文本的会话开关。本包是 y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 的 fork，已适配 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2：放宽 peer 范围以免被兼容性门禁整包拒绝、用 `ctx.settings.configure()` 与配置字段 `.volatile()` 替代被移除的 settings API、更新已改名的客户端图标、并让上游 SSE 错误直接报错（不再返回空消息污染会话历史）。此外还修掉了改名为 `-free` 后遗留的两处问题：会话列表路由原先按旧包名继承下来的硬编码长度切分路径，导致登录正常但每个会话请求都返回 404；侧边栏会话浮层原先用宿主的半透明菜单色，而该色只有配合磨砂背景才像菜单、挂到 body 上的面板无法安装磨砂，现已改用不透明表面色。

description.en: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.
description.zh: 项目收尾用的交付回执面板。触发一次即汇总分支与 commit、测试与构建结果、截图的宽高与 sha256、密钥扫描结论，然后只按证据把每一条分进三区：已验证、仅本地、未验证。落在未验证区的声明只保留标签，正文位置显式留空而不是把声明印出来——措辞自信而背后什么都没有的句子，正是回执要防的东西。测试失败与密钥扫描命中同样是有证据的事实，因此进已验证区并带红色色调，而不是被悄悄丢掉。

description.en: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的状态栏里实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 读数：可点击的徽章、详情面板、逐项开关与三档刷新速度。

description.en: Offline Beijing-time peak/idle indicator below the conversation composer, with a 2026 calendar, uncertainty labels, and brief peak reminders; no API key or runtime network access required.
description.zh: 会话输入框下方的离线北京时间峰谷指示器，内置 2026 年日历、待确认状态和短暂高峰提醒，运行时无需密钥或联网。

description.en: Prior-art search for an idea: three tools find similar open-source projects on GitHub, rank them by a score computed in code from a relevance judgement and the star count, then read the chosen repositories (README, dependency manifest, directory tree, key files) and report the class and function declarations found in each file header; files_read lists what was actually fetched.
description.zh: 动手造轮子之前先做同类调研：三个工具在 GitHub 上搜索与想法相似的开源项目，按代码根据相关性判断与 star 数算出的得分排序，再读取选中的仓库（README、依赖清单、目录树、关键文件），报告每个文件头里扫到的类与函数声明，并用 files_read 列出实际读了哪些文件。

description.en: Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click — Git-like history without needing Git, for folders that never had a repo (game saves, app config dirs, loose documents). Snapshots are content-addressed and deduplicated, and unchanged files are not re-hashed. Automatic snapshots come in two modes: realtime (fs.watch — one version ~8s after the last change, so a save-all or a build counts once) and timed (checks every N minutes, stores only when something actually changed; identical content never adds an empty version). Empty folders are recorded and recreated on restore. Every restore takes a safety snapshot first, so a rollback is itself undoable, and exact-mode cleanup only removes files and empty folders — a non-empty folder is never deleted. Ships a folder_timemachine model tool (status/history/diff need no approval; writes ask first) plus a floating panel with the timeline, one-click restore and mode switching. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies, 110 tests included.
description.zh: 给任意文件夹留下历史时间点并一键回到过去：像 Git 一样有版本历史，但不需要懂 Git，任何文件夹都能用（游戏存档、软件配置目录、散落文档都行）。快照按内容寻址去重，只存真正变化的文件，未变文件不重算哈希；自动存档分两档——实时（fs.watch，最后一次改动静默约 8 秒后存一版，编辑器一次保存或一次构建算一版）与定时（每 N 分钟检查，有变化才存，内容没变不产生空版本）。空文件夹也会被记录，恢复时一并重建（mod 加载器、存档扫描器常要求某个空夹存在）。每次恢复前自动存一个安全还原点，因此恢复本身可撤销；exact 模式只删多余文件与空目录，非空目录一律不动。附带模型工具 folder_timemachine（status/history/diff 免审批，写操作走审批）与左下角浮窗面板（时间线、一键恢复、实时/定时切换）。纯 JS、零运行时依赖、自带 110 项测试。

description.en: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中接入 Kimi 模型，并按模型选择嵌入式 Kimi 核心或 DSH 原生执行方式。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness desktop app icon (exe, tray and Start Menu) with any uploaded .ico, and restores the stock icon on demand.
description.zh: 更换 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端应用图标（exe、托盘、开始菜单），支持上传任意 .ico，并可随时还原官方默认图标。

description.en: Generates release material from what a local repository can actually support: a hero image, a feature grid and bilingual copy rendered as SVG and HTML from `README.md`, `package.json` and optional screenshots. Facts are quoted from those files — name, version, license, summary, features, install snippet — and a field that is missing is left unrendered rather than filled with placeholder text. Every feature carries a source citation such as `README.md#L42`, and a claim the repository cannot substantiate is linted out before anything is written, with the reasoning left in `lint-report.json`. `manifest.json` records a sha256 for each input and output, and `--now` or `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` makes a run byte-identical. Also ships a GUI panel that regenerates from inside a session.
description.zh: 从本地仓库真实支持的产物生成发布素材：hero 图、特性网格与中英双语文案，由 `README.md`、`package.json` 和可选截图渲染成 SVG 与 HTML。事实全部从这些文件引用——项目名、版本、license、一句话简介、特性列表、安装片段——缺失的字段直接不渲染，不补占位文案。每条特性带 `README.md#L42` 这样的来源标注；无法被本仓库证实的说法在写出之前就被 lint 掉，理由留在 `lint-report.json`。`manifest.json` 记录每个输入与输出文件的 sha256，`--now` 或 `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` 可让整次输出字节一致。另含一个可以在会话里重新生成的 GUI 面板。

description.en: Cross-session meeting room for DSH: a host session opens a room with a topic and a round limit, invites other sessions in order, they speak one at a time, and the meeting closes with written minutes.
description.zh: 跨会话会议室：主持人开房定题、定轮次，按顺序邀请其它会话，一位一位发言，轮次用满即收会出纪要。

description.en: Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.
description.zh: 通过无头运行的 Logseq CLI，把 Logseq 2.0 DB 图谱（含 E2EE 加密图谱）与同步服务器保持同步，提供 11 个 logseq_* 工具用于搜索、查询和编辑，并在设置页里登录和配置同步。

description.en: Markdown input for the composer that keeps the typed Markdown as the sent text while drawing bullets and checkboxes, styling bold, italic, inline code, strikethrough, headings, quotes and fenced code blocks, continuing lists on Shift+Enter, and wrapping selections with Cmd/Ctrl+B, I and E.
description.zh: 输入框 Markdown 书写辅助：发送内容保持原始 Markdown，同时把列表显示为圆点和复选框，实时呈现粗体、斜体、行内代码、删除线、标题、引用与代码块，Shift+Enter 自动续写列表，选中文字可用 Cmd/Ctrl+B、I、E 加格式。

description.en: Adds a dshmarket entry to the DSH sidebar footer, sharing a row with the Agents-Anywhere remote-control entry and sitting to its right, and opens the market panel in an overlay.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部加入 dshmarket 入口，与 Agents-Anywhere 的「远程控制」同处一行并位于其右侧，点击以浮层打开市场面板。

description.en: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and the table of 142 is editable in one JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框里的 LaTeX 片段展开，触发词表直接取自 Obsidian Latex Suite 的默认片段——138 条打完即出，Tab 依次跳 tabstop，142 条全在一份可编辑的 JSON 里。

description.en: Settings panel for MCP servers registered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: toggle each server on or off with live effect, see the registered tool count and estimated context-token cost of each server, and persist the choice to the home cordis.patch.yml with a timestamped backup before every write. Maintained fork of dsh-mcp-toggle.
description.zh: 面向 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 注册的 MCP 服务器的设置面板：逐个开关服务器（即时生效），显示各服务器的已注册工具数与预估上下文 token 开销，并将选择持久化到主目录 cordis.patch.yml，每次写入前保留带时间戳的备份。dsh-mcp-toggle 的维护分支。

description.en: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话卡片内显示本地图片与短视频并提供原文件一键下载，也可为任意其他本地文件提供下载；本机与远程连接均可用，媒体本身不进入模型的视觉上下文。

description.en: Persistent agent-preset (mode) selector docked in the composer input bar: switch the mode for new tasks, and set the new-task default from any running session.
description.zh: 对话框常驻的 Agent 预设（模式）选择条：新任务直接切换模式，运行中的会话可一键设为新任务默认。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
description.zh: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

description.en: Plays an intro full-frame when you open DSH, when you open a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. The built-in footage is themed on a Wandering Earth-style space station and the quantum AI MOSS (550W): a red single eye ignites while the Earth’s curve slides past the viewport. Four clips ship embedded in the code — no separate video files — and the library lets you tick any number to rotate at random (never the same clip twice in a row), preview the rotation, or swap in your own videos. Sound plays without a click; the pin button sits beside Settings.
description.zh: 打开 DSH 时、打开新对话时，或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，播放一段全屏片头动画。内置素材是《流浪地球》风格的太空站与量子 AI MOSS（550W）：红色单眼点亮，地球弧线从视窗外掠过。四段片子直接内嵌在代码里，不需要单独的视频文件；片库可勾选任意几段随机轮换（不会连续两次同一段）、预览轮换，也能换成你自己的视频。声音无需点击即可播放；钉住按钮就在设置旁边。

description.en: Multi-select clear (archive) workspace conversations and bulk-delete empty workspaces in the DSH sidebar. Workspace-level selection (tri-state), select-all, progress and failure reporting; delete keeps folders and session logs (sessions move to Ungrouped).
description.zh: 侧边栏多选清空(归档)工作区对话，并批量删除已清空的空工作区。支持会话行/工作区头行勾选、半选态、全选、二次确认与失败保留；删除工作区保留文件夹与日志，会话移至未分组。

description.en: Workspace groups for the DSH sidebar with group navigation and session status indicators.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏提供工作区分组、组间导航和会话状态提示。

description.en: Local TXT novel reader in the DSH right sidebar: bookshelf with file, directory and path import, chapter table of contents with jump, click-to-turn or vertical-scroll paging, reading progress restored across restarts, and font, line-spacing, background and night themes.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏本地 TXT 小说阅读器：书架三种导入、章节目录跳转、点击翻页与上下滚动、重启后进度恢复、字体/行距/背景/夜间阅读主题。

description.en: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original preview.
description.zh: 点击交付文件卡片时用系统默认程序打开文件，而不是在 DSH 侧边栏里预览；按住 Shift 保留原来的预览行为。

description.en: Inspect and tidy a real Android phone over adb: storage surveys, per-app data sizes read from dumpsys diskstats without root, cache clearing that preserves app data, directory measurements and screenshots — five tools; reads never modify anything, writes require explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 用 adb 查看并打理一台真实的 Android 手机：存储体检、未 root 也能读到的逐应用数据大小（来自 dumpsys diskstats）、只清缓存不动数据的清理、目录统计与截图——共五个工具；读取永不改动任何东西，写入必须显式确认。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Per-session color tags for DeepSeek Harness: hover a sidebar session row to pick one of 12 colors, with a colored bar on tagged rows and host-side persistence.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的每个会话标颜色：悬停侧栏会话行即可选色（12 色），被标色行显示同色竖条，宿主侧持久化。

description.en: Zotero library in a read-only sidebar panel: browse collections, search items, read metadata and full text, and insert a single citation, a selected excerpt, or a whole collection into the conversation draft. A self-hosted bridge connects to the local Zotero integration MCP and registers its tools to the model as mcp__zotero__*, each one individually toggleable.
description.zh: 把 Zotero 文献库放进只读右侧栏面板：浏览分类树、搜索条目、查看元数据与 PDF 全文，并把单条目引用、划词摘录或整目录引用写进会话草稿。插件自持连接本机 Zotero 集成 MCP，把工具以 mcp__zotero__* 注册给模型，可按工具逐个启用 / 禁用。

description.en: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.
description.zh: 一张只有你一个人类的无限注德州扑克桌。八个座位：你，加上七位以 AI 创始人设写成的 LLM 智能体（Altman、达里奥、马斯克、梁文峰、黄仁勋、雷军、张一鸣）。每个智能体都通过宿主当前选中的模型下注，模型不可用时回落到自己的启发式风格；每个智能体只看得见自己的底牌，因为提示词只由它自己那个座位拼出来。一手结束时亮出赢家底牌，每张公共牌落地都会重播翻牌动画，侧栏保留实时的行动与桌边闲话时间线。局域网模式默认关闭、不影响单机玩法：同一网络里的另一份安装可以加入这张桌，主机屏幕显示 6 位房间号，UDP 广播负责发现附近的牌桌，加入者随机顶替一名人机座位，离开或静默二十秒后座位交还该角色。房间号从不上广播，且每份快照都按观看者座位生成，所以没有人（连主机也不行）能读到别人的底牌。本仓库是 BubblePtr/dsh-holdem（MIT）的 fork，README 与界面都保留了上游署名。

description.en: Preset doctor for agent presets: scans home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` declarations and legacy `.agent-presets/` dirs across host lines 0.1.0→0.2.0, shows every detected preset as an official-style card (source/era badges, broken red border, per-finding details, current DSH version + era catalog), and syncs a preset to the current syntax per-card behind an explicit confirm dialog (.bak backup + atomic write; report-level findings are never written — startup scans are report-only). npm: `dsh-preset-doctor`.
description.zh: Agent 预设医生：跨宿主线（0.1.0→0.2.0）扫描 home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` 声明与遗留 `.agent-presets/` 目录，把检测到的每个预设以官方同款卡片展示（来源/代际徽章、失效红边、逐条修复项明细、当前 DSH 版本与代际目录）；卡内「同步到当前版本」走显式确认框（.bak 备份 + 原子写，需人工裁决项永不写盘，启动扫描恒只报告）。npm 包名：`dsh-preset-doctor`。

description.en: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文本引用/自动复制与鼠标右键直接粘贴。

description.en: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion, plus a Phone-settings panel with seven inline cards inside the DSH WebUI settings.
description.zh: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里内联渲染七张折叠卡片（根目录 / 远程访问 / 设备 / 识图 / 回收站 / 审计 / App 下载）。

description.en: Makes the DSH Settings dialog resizable from its edges and corners and movable by its top strip, remembering the chosen size across opens.
description.zh: 让 DSH 设置弹窗可拖动边和角改变大小、按住顶部横带移动位置，并记住尺寸。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加基于本机回环接口的重启按钮，按当前进程的可执行文件、参数和工作目录请求重新启动。

description.en: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite each command and adopting what it prints; when rtk is absent the executor behaves exactly like the stock one.
description.zh: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk（Rust Token Killer）执行，让工具输出在进入模型之前就被压缩：插件调用本机 rtk 重写命令并采纳其结果；rtk 未安装时，执行器行为与原生完全一致。

description.en: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
description.zh: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

description.en: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.
description.zh: Cursor 与 GitHub PR Review 风格划词引用与批注插件：支持划词一键引用到对话（⌘L）、行内展开写批注（⇧⌘L）及输入框上方批注汇总栏一键插入。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web client and a translate button appears at the end of the selection; clicking it translates that text in place. Translation goes through the host llm service, so it reuses the model the current session already has selected and needs no separate API key; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be configured instead. The result opens in a popover that stays inside the viewport, with one-click copy, a row of language buttons for instant retranslation, and smart Chinese-to-English / other-to-Chinese as the default. Configuration is stored host-side and its API key is never sent to the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页客户端里选中文字，选区末尾会出现一个翻译按钮，点击即就地翻译这段文字。翻译走宿主 llm 服务，直接复用当前会话已选的模型，无需另外配置 API Key；也可改用任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。结果在保持于视口内的浮层中展示，支持一键复制、一排语言按钮即时重译，默认智能中英互译（中文译英、其他语言译中）。配置保存在宿主端，其中的 API Key 永不下发到浏览器。

description.en: System notifications, a tab-title dot and a PWA taskbar badge when a reply finishes in the background or a session waits for your approval, plan review or answer, all cleared when you return to the window.
description.zh: 会话在后台跑完、或在等你审批、计划审阅或回答时，弹出系统通知、标题加红点并点亮 PWA 任务栏徽标；回到窗口自动清除。

description.en: A plugin to completely delete sessions and clean up the associated files in the .dsh/sessions directory.
description.zh: 用于彻底删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并同步清理 .dsh/sessions 目录下相关文件的插件。

description.en: Retrospective agent-session evaluation: deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs from persisted logs — no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.
description.zh: 回溯式会话评估：从持久化日志生成确定性成绩卡与跨会话回归对比——不跑基准、不用 LLM 裁判。

description.en: Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.
description.zh: 侧栏会话树 - 原生子代理树,外加可选的组织汇报层级;折叠分支计数,孤儿/环路防御。

description.en: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.
description.zh: 项目收尾时生成一张可公开的交付回执。`ship_receipt` 工具自己测量能测的、记录被告知的，再把每一条硬性分进三区：已验证（本次采集到、且能在别处复现的证据——真跑过的命令与退出码、已入版本库文件的哈希、确实扫到文件的扫描、本地记录的远端里存在的 git 引用）、仅本地（只在这台机器上成立——未提交改动、未推送提交、别人看不到的产物）、未验证（没有证据，包括人写的任何一句话）。没有证据的声明只留标签、正文留空，而不是把声明照原样印出来；回执里含分支与 commit、产物的字节数与 sha256（PNG 附带宽高），以及推送前三步检查的结论。

description.en: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.
description.zh: 侧边栏文件树增强：重命名、新建、上传、下载（目录当场打包为 zip）、复制完整路径与删除；128 种文本扩展名的可编辑文档渲染器，支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存与版本冲突检测；另有一个独立的下侧终端面板，带标签页与持久化在 DSH home 里的快捷命令库。

description.en: A small pet in the corner of the interface that reads the real event stream instead of guessing: it drifts when idle, speeds up while the agent is thinking, draws a flowing line per running tool call, turns red and shakes with the error summary on a failure, and celebrates a turn that ran longer than ten seconds. The same widget is the at-a-glance busy and error indicator, so there is no spinner to stare at. The host half folds real harness events into a snapshot and the client half only draws it; it performs no content recognition, and it positions itself away from the composer so it never sits over what you are typing.
description.zh: 界面角落里的一只小宠物，读的是真实事件流而不是猜：空闲时慢慢飘，agent 思考时动得更快，每个正在运行的工具调用拉一条流动的连线，出错时变红、抖一下并显示错误摘要，跑超过十秒的回合结束时庆祝。它同时就是那个一眼可见的忙碌/出错指示器，不用再盯着转圈。宿主半区把真实 harness 事件折叠成快照，客户端半区只负责画；它不做内容识别，并且会主动避开输入框，不会趴在你正在打字的地方。

description.en: Live skill provider that reads every Xiaomi MiMo (MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode) skill into the DSH session catalog: the engine-bundled skills under engine-config (unpacked from app.asar when that directory is absent), the MiMoCode global and project roots, extension-contributed skill directories declared in extensions.json, and the brand compatibility roots MiMo's own skillPathCompat setting enables.
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把小米 MiMo（MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode）的全部 skill 读进 DSH 会话技能目录——engine-config 下的引擎内置技能（该目录缺失时从 app.asar 解包）、MiMoCode 全局与项目根、extensions.json 里扩展贡献的技能目录，以及 MiMo 自己的 skillPathCompat 开关启用的品牌兼容根。

description.en: One-click toggles for skills and MCP at both global and project scope.
description.zh: Skill 与 MCP 的全局 + 项目粒度一键启停开关。

description.en: Records session snapshots and supports rollback to previous states.
description.zh: 记录会话快照并支持回滚到之前的状态。

description.en: Three switchable low-glare themes (Warm Paper, Sage Green, Warm Grey) for the DeepSeek Harness GUI, each a full alias-token layer with a light and a dark face.
description.zh: 三套可切换的低刺激护眼配色（暖纸、豆绿、暖灰），每套都是完整的别名 token 层，含浅色与深色两副面貌。

description.en: Turns the composer's reasoning-effort menu into a draggable slider and takes over the stock model-and-reasoning-level chip. Dragging follows the pointer continuously; releasing snaps to the nearest level and submits one session update per drag. The track draws its own fill, tick marks and white knob, only the highest levels (xhigh, max, ultra) get a flowing brand-colour gradient, and both ends carry the lowest and highest level names. The same card expands into the official model list. Arrow keys step one level, PageUp and PageDown two, Home and End jump to the ends, and each move submits. A generation counter on the directory object discards late responses, and reduced-motion turns the animations off. All data comes from the stock modelDirectories directory; no new capabilities are added.
description.zh: 把输入框右侧的「推理等级」从菜单点选换成可拖拽滑条，并接管官方那枚「模型 · 推理等级」chip。拖动中连续跟手，松手吸附到最近档位，且一次拖拽只提交一次会话更新。轨道内自绘填充、刻度点与白圆钮，只有最高档（xhigh/max/ultra）才铺品牌色流动渐变，两端标出最低与最高档名；同一张卡片可展开官方模型清单。方向键移动一档、PageUp/PageDown 移动两档、Home/End 跳到两端，每次移动都会提交。目录对象上的世代计数器丢弃迟到的响应，prefers-reduced-motion 下关闭动画。数据全部取自官方 modelDirectories，不新增任何能力。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved) backed by ctx.storageDomain, so scripts can be stored, retrieved and re-run with new arguments.
description.zh: 官方 workflow 工具的 drop-in 增强版：在逐字 fork 的官方工具之上，用 ctx.storageDomain 提供持久化的 saved workflow 库（workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved），可把编排脚本存库、检索并带新参数重跑。

description.en: A social deduction game played against your own model configurations. A table has N seats (six by default, one of them yours) and some of the rest are played by agents bound to different provider, model, temperature, system prompt and disguise settings; you interrogate them and cross-check the answers to work out which seats are not human. Seat identity and each agent model configuration stay hidden in the host state until a seat is judged, then the disguise parameters are revealed. Every round exports a per-seat conversation JSONL plus the judgment record, and the same seed with the same move script replays byte-identical, so runs with different models or disguise strengths can be diffed.
description.zh: 拿你自己的模型配置当对手玩的社交推理游戏。一张桌子有 N 个座位（默认 6 个，其中一个是你的），其余若干座位由绑定了不同 provider、model、temperature、system prompt 与伪装参数的 agent 扮演；你通过提问和交叉印证，判断哪些座位不是人。座位身份与每个 agent 的模型配置在判定前都不出现在 host 状态里，判定后才揭晓伪装参数。每局导出逐席位对话 JSONL 与判定记录，同一 seed 加同一份操作脚本可复现出逐字节相同的对局，于是换模型、换提示词、换伪装强度的几局可以直接 diff。

description.en: Pixel-level screenshot diff for visual regression. Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page. An ignore-region list with absolute or fractional coordinates excludes clocks, cursors and other per-render noise. It deliberately does no content recognition: it answers only "did this change", which is the part that can be made deterministic. Entirely local — no model call, no network, no upload.
description.zh: 面向视觉回归的像素级截图比对。输入两张本地 PNG，第一行是可机器判定的结论（`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`，可以直接 grep 当断言），随后是差异比例、差异区域包围盒、最大通道差与平均绝对误差，并生成一份自包含的 HTML 对照页。可用绝对或比例坐标声明忽略区，排除时钟、光标这类每次渲染都会变的部分。它刻意不做内容识别——只回答「变没变」，因为这一步可以做成确定性的。全部本地完成：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.
description.zh: 基于 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 的通用联网搜索插件：配置 baseURL / API Key / 模型即可让内置 web_search 工具对接 Qwen Token Plan、OpenAI 等任意网关。

description.en: Persistent WeChat bridge for DSH: one WeChat user maps to one persistent agent session via the official iLink channel, with context and the user-to-session registry surviving restarts. There is no sender allowlist — anyone who can message the paired WeChat account can start a conversation with a session that has tool access, and the working directory defaults to the home directory; use a dedicated account and set WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD.
description.zh: DSH 的持久微信桥：一个微信用户对应一个持久智能体会话，走官方 iLink 通道，上下文与用户→会话映射在重启后保留。没有发送者白名单——任何能给所配对微信号发消息的人都能发起对话并获得拥有工具权限的会话，工作目录默认是用户主目录；请使用专用账号并设置 WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD。

description.en: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plugin (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official) holds those slots too, so you must disable it in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart. Ships a swimming whale that follows light and dark themes through currentColor and is tuned to stay legible at the sidebar's 24 px.
description.zh: 把自己做的矢量 Logo 换到 DSH 侧栏与首屏标题旁，接管 sidebar.brand.mark / sidebar.brand.name / conversation.hero.brand.mark 这三个 single 槽位。包里自带的补丁只把自己插进 loader——这三个槽位同时被官方品牌插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official 占着，所以要先在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里把它 disabled，再重启 DSH。默认那只鲸鱼会游动，用 currentColor 跟随明暗主题，动效按侧栏 24px 的可读性调过。

description.en: Chooses which skills and MCP servers each workspace may use, from a "Skills & MCP" item in the workspace row's "..." menu; unchecked skills leave the session catalog, the `skill` tool and `/name`, and unchecked servers have their `mcp__<server>__*` tools denied for that workspace's sessions, running ones included from the next turn.
description.zh: 在侧栏工作区行的「…」菜单中新增「技能与 MCP」，按工作区勾选可用的技能与 MCP 服务器；取消勾选的技能从会话技能目录、`skill` 工具和 `/技能名` 中消失，取消勾选的服务器其 `mcp__<服务器>__*` 工具对该工作区的会话禁用，已在运行的会话从下一轮起生效。

description.en: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏工作区浏览器的分类树：工作区与其会话挂到自建分类下（折叠状态记忆），行可在分类间拖拽，新建工作区可直接落进某个分类（走系统目录选择器），分类可原地重命名与删除，底栏开关可把面板切回原生列表。

description.en: Generates a structured handoff card so a near-full conversation continues in a fresh zero-context session: /handoff writes the card with self-incrementing titles, pins it to the top of the sidebar and prepares the new session once the context nears its threshold.
description.zh: 用 /handoff 生成交接卡，让快满的对话在全新零上下文会话里接着跑：标题自动递增编号、卡片在侧栏置顶，接近阈值时自动备好新会话。

description.en: Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.
description.zh: 免密钥上网 MCP server：web_search、基于双 CDP Chrome 的 JS 渲染抓取（代理自动互备），以及 7 个隔离上下文真实浏览器 page_* 工具。

description.en: Provides 15 Superpowers skills for DeepSeek Harness, covering test-driven development, debugging, planning, and code review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 15 个 Superpowers 技能，覆盖测试驱动开发、调试、规划与代码评审。

description.en: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: a persistent PowerShell UIA backend behind 16 merged MCP entries (read/click/type/observe/verify), a hardened policy layer (red lines, approvals, observation binding, point-ownership and focus guards) and a performance pass (prewarm, caching, pixel-hash stability probe). Fork of dsh-computer-use-win.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的 Windows 计算机操作插件：常驻 PowerShell UIA 后端，对外只有 16 个合并入口（读取/点击/输入/观测/验证）；带加固的策略层（红线拒绝、显式审批、观测绑定、落点归属与前台焦点守卫）与一轮性能优化（后端预热、缓存、像素哈希稳定探测）。fork 自 dsh-computer-use-win。

description.en: YiHe pkg-dev knowledge packs for DeepSeek Harness: 52 domain packs and 90 RFB experience files for coding cognition.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 YiHe pkg-dev 知识包：52 个领域包与 90 个 RFB 经验文件，用于编程认知。

description.en: Zagent — unified three-role self-improvement loop with three operators. Data-RSI (daily cross-sectional cleaning: winsorize → cross-sectional standardization → median fill, plus experience extraction), Harness-RSI (evolves system prompt / memory / skills), and Model-RSI (evolves alpha training recipes via framework-native walk-forward with 2-day gap and multi-seed). Offline one-command run, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
description.zh: Zagent——统一 RSI 三角色自改进闭环框架，三个算子：Data-RSI（逐日截面清洗：去极值→截面驻日标准化→中位数填充，加经验提取）、Harness-RSI（进化系统提示词/记忆/技能）、Model-RSI（进化 alpha 训练配方，框架内置 walk-forward，含 2 天空白与多 seed）。离线一条命令跑，GPU 自动走 CUDA。附带一个 skill。
